decision: Check that target T has the declared source-specific target-disease association in Open Targets release 26.06; do not upgrade association to causality or efficacy.

claim_contract.units: scores retain Open Targets source definition and release semantics

data_clock.as_of_rule: Only release 26.06 rows support this world; later release rows are a different world version.
data_clock.snapshot_policy: Retain the exact bounded GraphQL response outside git; its hash and three derived rows define this world version.

sources.custody: No live query in public runtime; exact query response bytes remain in ignored preflight artifacts.

material_assumptions: Target and disease identifiers are exact Open Targets identifiers.
Evidence source and score meaning remain source-specific.
Causal, clinical-efficacy, universal, and wrong-release language is out of scope.

decisive_controls.isolation: SEC/Arc records cannot satisfy this claim

public_policy: Only sanitized, release-cited association receipts may cross the public boundary.
